notes.title: Night Escape is Free to Play!
notes.content:
Motivation:
In making our game free on Steam, we aim to reach a broader audience and provide an inclusive gaming experience for players around the world. We believe that by removing the barrier of entry, we can offer our unique gaming concept to a wider demographic, fostering a more diverse and engaged community. Additionally, this decision aligns with our commitment to accessibility, allowing players of varying backgrounds and financial means to enjoy and participate in our creative endeavor. By going free, we aspire to create a vibrant and thriving community, encouraging more players to explore, enjoy, and share our game with others.

Existing Users:
For our existing users, the transition to a free model on Steam brings several positive changes. Firstly, it opens up opportunities for increased player engagement as more individuals join the community. The larger player base contributes to a livelier and more dynamic gaming environment, with more interactions, competitions, and shared experiences. Additionally, by making the game free, we hope to express gratitude to our loyal players who have been part of our journey, offering them a chance to continue enjoying the game without any financial commitment. We are dedicated to maintaining a seamless experience for our current users and enhancing their gaming journey as the community grows.

notes.title: Update - Haunting Curses!
notes.content:
Get ready for an even more chilling experience in Night Escape! In this exciting update, we introduce a brand new element to the game: Ghost Curses! Now, the ghosts have the power to unleash terrifying curses upon the assassin, making the hunt for the innocents even more intense.

Explore an arsenal of haunting curses capable of blinding, stunning, and paralyzing the assassin. These sinister abilities offer the ghosts a new strategy to thwart the dark plans of the assassin, while the innocents struggle to survive.

Join us on this thrilling journey and discover the power of haunting curses. Will you be able to confront the ghosts and overcome these new adversities? Brace yourself for a completely revamped gameplay experience, filled with suspense!

Download the update now and become part of this dark world of Night Escape. Feel the thrill, challenge your fears, and prove that you have the courage to face the haunting curses that await you. Are you ready for this new era of terror?

notes.title: Update 0.0.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Addition of cooldown when the assassin kills someone.
[*] Addition of time to arm and disarm the electrical panels.
[*] The assassin can now also activate the electrical panels, as it was previously an ability used by the innocents to uncover the assassin. This makes it more challenging to identify the assassin.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Modified the initial respawn location of players.
[*] Changed the key for player elimination by the assassin to a more accessible key.
[*] Fixed a minor bug with the player count bar in the lobby.
[*] Improved the player respawn process during game loading.
[*] Enhanced the presentation of player names in the voting frames during the meeting room.
[*] Reduced the voting timer once all players have voted to expedite the process.
[*] Added an end-of-voting information screen displaying the most voted player and the result of correctly identifying the assassin or executing an innocent player.
[*] Resolved occasional screen freezing issues at the end of the game.
[*] Fixed automatic text filling in the chat upon opening the screen.
[*] Improved the respawn process for ghosts.
[*] Addressed incorrect notifications about the need for keys to open doors at inappropriate times.
[*] Implemented a tutorial button on the main menu leading to a comprehensive tutorial covering the roles of innocents, assassins, and ghosts.
[*] Included the name of the assassin in the victory screen for innocents and the victory screen for the assassin.
[*] Enhanced the message the assassin receives during the initial seconds of the game to clearly indicate their role as the assassin.
[*] Improved game sounds overall.
[*] Assassins now hear the sounds of approaching ghosts, allowing them to attempt evasive maneuvers even without direct visibility.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor was disappearing when using the "Alt + Tab" function.
[/list]
